evidence_status: Researcher-defined illustrative configuration; not an elicited organisational policy
timing_policy: Only endpoint timestamps within this explicit broad plausibility range are usable; this does not certify the extraction date. The first recorded event of a kind is selected before its timestamp is checked. Non-negative first-invoice-receipt to first-clearing lag only.
resource_identity_policy: A usable resource identity matches user_[0-9]+ or batch_[0-9]+ completely, ignoring letter case and surrounding whitespace. Only user_[0-9]+ counts as a user-attributed event; every other label, NONE and empty values are unusable, never silently human or automated.
lag_interpretation: First invoice receipt to first clearing is a first-endpoint trace quantity; it does not match multiple invoices, receipts or clearings into individual invoice cycles
primary_reference: mean of all scored cases under the selected view

criteria.name: No recorded invoice receipt
criteria.evidence_policy: absence within recorded history, not proof of non-completion

criteria.name: No recorded clearing
criteria.evidence_policy: absence within recorded history, not proof of non-completion

criteria.name: No recorded goods or service receipt
Long observed invoice-to-clearing lag
criteria.evidence_policy: both first timestamps observed and plausible; non-negative lag

criteria.name: Invoice precedes goods or service receipt
criteria.evidence_policy: both first timestamps observed and plausible; equality permitted

criteria.name: Recorded user-attributed events
criteria.evidence_policy: every event resource usable; a missing or unusable event resource makes the full count unavailable

criteria.name: Distinct recorded user identities
criteria.evidence_policy: every event resource usable; a missing or unusable event resource makes the full count unavailable

view_weight_policy: Each criterion receives its layer's stated raw weight; these are per-criterion weights, not target layer totals.
tie_policy: descending Priority Index, then descending number of scored cases, then ascending group key
claim_boundary: Recorded concern under illustrative settings; no validated ownership, actual labour effort, causal diagnosis, financial loss or intervention-effect claim
